open_questions: gentity_s conflict: this chunk fixes gentity_s at stride 0x230 (g_08716400). Other chunks using gentity_s (chunk_005, chunk_020, chunk_023 types) describe other layouts (0x274 stride, cod2_gentity_s with contents at 0x11c). The merge lane must reconcile which array this is.

playerstate_s identity: view_motion_s.ps points to a structure with fields up to 0x5b8 (yaw, lean, pm_flags, stance blend, view angles, speed scale). Its owner (gclient sub-struct, entity sub-struct, or separate playerState) is not established by this chunk.

view_motion_s slot meanings: slot_14 is an int in 80f14aa/80f21ba but is passed as raw float bits in 80f237e; slot_1c is both the kick-B current time (80f166c) and a slewed sway value (80f1ede); slot_20 is both a start time and a pointer in 80f1ede. Field types and roles need confirmation against the callers (80f1c60 etc.).

Merged signature mismatch (0x080a3d66): the shared prototype Angle_ApproachProportionalWrapped is void, but 0x080a3d66 tail-calls 0x080a8476 which leaves its float result in st(0), and this chunk uses the value. The chunk calls it through a float-returning function-pointer cast (Angle_ApproachProportionalWrapped_F) so it compiles against the shared header; the merge lane should fix the shared prototype to float and drop the cast. Scr_IsInitialized is called with one int argument in the binary (merged says void(void)); translated as a no-argument call.
Com_Error is assumed non-returning (as in the merged name). If it returns in the binary, BG_LoadWeaponDef and KeyValue_ParseBlock continue past the error path in this translation.
Weapon table parse types (0 string, 4/5/7 int-like, 6 float, 8..15 enums) are recovered from the table words and used only as the string/float split; enum spellings are not recovered.

Bit-exact float behaviour under x87 extended precision is not verified; float/double placement follows Ghidra constant types, and long double is used only where the binary uses long double (Float_SquareLD, Vec2_LengthSquared).
Out-of-chunk callees: 38 of 64 callees are fn_08xxxxxx placeholders with no merged name in the current symbols set. Prototypes for them are provisional and live in chunk_045_types.h.
